page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.8xlarge is a storage-oriented instance type within the Local SSDs family, designed to provide high-capacity local flash storage alongside a balanced compute profile. Running on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 architecture, the instance is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The configuration allocates 32 virtual CPUs derived from 16 physical cores via hyperthreading, backed by 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache per core, and a 33 MB shared L3 cache. It incorporates hardware instruction support for AVX, AVX-512F, AES, and BMI2.

System memory consists of 128.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio at 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance comes equipped with 3839 GB of bundled local SSD storage directly attached to the host, eliminating dependence on network-attached storage volumes for high-throughput disk workloads. Network connectivity features a baseline bandwidth rate of 6 Gbps, while graphics processing units are absent.

Performance profiles demonstrate moderate multi-threaded efficiency paired with lower single-threaded throughput. In benchmarks, the 32 vCPUs produce average-tier multi-core results across the Geekbench multi-core test (8435.0) and PassMark CPU score (23054.0), while single-threaded tasks show weak metrics, such as a Geekbench single-core score of 968.0 and lower gzip compression speeds. Memory bandwidth reaches 87.06 GB/sec for uncached read blocks and 43.34 GB/sec for uncached write blocks, alongside average throughput in database operations and Redis SET testing reaching 23.21 million operations per second.

From an infrastructure perspective, the ecs.i2g.8xlarge trades peak per-core compute speeds for high density in multi-core scalability and integrated high-capacity disk storage. The primary hardware tradeoff lies in the older Skylake-era CPU generation, which results in modest per-thread performance and basic network bandwidth. This server type is best suited for localized transactional databases, distributed storage nodes, caching layers, batch data processing, and enterprise application hosting requiring directly attached SSD capacity.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.8xlarge is a dedicated instance type from the Local SSDs family, configured with 32 vCPUs from 16 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The system provides 128.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio, and includes 3839 GB of bundled local SSD storage with a 6 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark results reveal an architecture tailored for multi-threaded workloads rather than single-core performance, exhibiting average multi-core CPU capacity alongside weaker single-threaded compute metrics. The memory subsystem maintains standard throughput across large-block reads and writes, complemented by stable Redis and database test results. Given the combination of dedicated compute resources, integrated local flash storage, and 128 GB of RAM, this instance functions well for transactional databases, NoSQL clusters, caching tiers, and localized data analytics.
